title: Malicious litellm_init.pth in litellm 1.82.8 PyPI package – credential stealer
cleaned_content: The `litellm` PyPI packages 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 were found to be compromised with a `litellm_init.pth` file designed to steal credentials. This supply chain attack on a widely used LLM proxy library highlights critical security vulnerabilities in the open-source ecosystem, particularly for tools managing sensitive API keys. Engineers should immediately audit their environments and pin dependency versions to mitigate risks.

title: Hypura – A storage-tier-aware LLM inference scheduler for Apple Silicon
cleaned_content: Hypura is an LLM inference scheduler for Apple Silicon that intelligently manages model loading and execution across different storage tiers (e.g., DRAM, SSD). This tool optimizes local inference performance and efficiency, especially for large models exceeding RAM capacity, by minimizing data movement bottlenecks. It offers a practical solution for deploying larger LLMs more effectively on consumer-grade hardware.
